999008199.text: たっだいまー！

あぁ、やっと戻ってきた。このイェルカさんが
遊びに来たってのに、出かけてるんだから

localizations.en: Well, well, look who's finally back. Here I am paying you a visit, and you're out and about!

999008199.text:
やっほー、イェルカ。
なになに？　また旅の話でもしにきてくれた？

localizations.en: Heya, Jelka! What's up? Come to share more stories from your travels?

999008199.text:
ベップの初仕事だったんだろ？
どうだい、新人聖戦士の実力のほどは

localizations.en: That was Bepp's first assignment, wasn't it? How'd our rookie Sacred Knight do?

999008199.text: 腕は申し分ないって、ヤンネさんのお墨付きだよ

localizations.en: Janne gave her skills two thumbs up!

999008199.text:
そりゃ頼もしい。
今度、アタシとも手合わせしてみるかい？

localizations.en: That's promising! Care for a friendly match with me sometime?

999008199.text:
悪いけど、必要のない狩りはしてはダメだって、
故郷の村の教えがあるから……

localizations.en: Sorry, but my village teachings forbid fighting without purpose...

999008199.text:
へぇ、ベップはそういう考え方だったのか。
だとしたら、粋じゃない提案をしちまったな

localizations.en: Oh? I didn't know that was how you felt about it, Bepp. Guess that wasn't very chic of me.

999008199.text: イェルカはどうして、そんなに粋にこだわるの？

localizations.en: Why do you care so much about being chic, Jelka?

999008199.text:
ある人の生き様を見て、粋だなぁ、
自分も、こうありたいなぁって思ったのさ

localizations.en: I saw how someone lived their life once, and thought 'Now that's chic.' Made me want to live that way too.

999008199.text: ほぅほぅ。ホーホーホッホウ、ホーホーホッホウ
キジバト！
正解！　さすが姉御

localizations.en: Spot on! That's Jelka for you!

999008199.text:
そういや、さっきシトリンに会ったんだけどね。
お前さんとひと悶着あったんだって？

localizations.en: By the way, I ran into Citrine earlier. Heard you had a bit of a run-in with her?

999008199.text: そうなんだよー！　相変わらずいけ好かない奴！

localizations.en: Ugh, yeah! Still can't stand her!

999008199.text:
ま、確かに生意気なところはあるね。
アタシはそこもかわいいと思うけど

localizations.en: Well, she can be a bit cheeky, I'll give you that. Though I find it kind of endearing.

999008199.text:
シトリンの奴が話してたんだが、どうやらあいつ、
水不足の問題に首を突っ込むみたいだよ

localizations.en: Citrine was telling me she's planning to stick her nose into the water shortage problem.

999008199.text: ン、そうなの！？
もし解決できれば大儲けだって、やる気になってたよ

localizations.en: She's all fired up about making a fortune if she can solve it.

999008199.text: ぐぬぬ……そんなことまで考えてたなんて

localizations.en: Grrrr... So she was thinking that far ahead...

999008199.text:
アウグスト、水不足ってのは
錬金術でどうにかできないわけ？

localizations.en: Hey August, couldn't alchemy help with the water shortage somehow?

999008199.text:
模索すれば手立てはあるだろう。
錬金術の可能性は無限大だ

localizations.en: With proper research, there might be a way. The possibilities of alchemy are limitless.

999008199.text:
（もしかしてこれって、アタシの力を
　世に知らしめる絶好の機会……！？）

localizations.en: (Wait... could this be the perfect chance to show everyone what I can do...!?)

999008199.text:
（水不足を錬金術でなんとかすれば、正式な
　活動を認めてもらえるよう、交渉ができる）

localizations.en: (If I can solve the water shortage with alchemy, I might be able to negotiate for official recognition!)

999008199.text:
しかし、今の私では不可能だろうな。
気力も、体力も追いつかん

localizations.en: However, it would be impossible for me now. I lack both the energy and strength.

999008199.text: 素敵老紳士の師匠といえど、寄る年波には勝てませぬか

localizations.en: Even our distinguished gentleman of a master can't fight Father Time, huh?

999008199.text:
……師匠ではなく、アタシが錬金術でやってみるのは
どう思いますかね

localizations.en: ...What would you think about me trying to solve it with alchemy instead of Master?

999008199.text: へぇ、お前さんが？
少なくとも、私より可能性はあるだろう

localizations.en: You certainly have more potential than I do at this point.

999008199.text: そ、そうかな？　やっぱり？
（やってやる……アルビちゃんは、やれる子だ！）

localizations.en: (I can do this... I've got what it takes!)

999008199.text:
よーし、シトリンに先を越されてたまるか！
この問題はアタシが解決してやる！

localizations.en: Alright, no way I'm letting Citrine beat me to it! I'll solve this problem myself!

999008199.text: おぉー、いい決意表明だねぇ。心がこもってる

localizations.en: Ooh, now that's what I call a declaration! You really mean it!

999008199.text:
師匠、できるだけ気を付けますが、
ちょっと動きは派手になります

localizations.en: Master, I'll try to be careful, but things might get a bit flashy.

999008199.text:
こういう時に役立ってこその錬金術だ。
やれるだけやってみろ

localizations.en: This is exactly what alchemy should be used for. Do what you must.

999008199.text:
狩りも、ここで動くというタイミングが大事。
姉様は今、人生で動くべきタイミングを肌で感じている

localizations.en: In hunting, timing is everything. Sister, I can sense that you've found the right moment to make your move in life.

999008199.text: そんな姉様を応援することを、誓う

localizations.en: I swear to support you in your endeavors.

999008199.text: じゃあ、アタシたちはこのへんで
気を付けて帰るんだよ

localizations.en: Take care on your way back!
